p = Path("chart.py")
source = p.read_text()
start = source.index("data = {")
end = source.index("df['Aid_Value_Millions'] =")
source = source[:start] + 'df = pd.read_csv("table.csv")\n' + source[end:]
source = source.replace("go.Bar(", "go.Funnel(")
source = source.replace('    hoverinfo="x+name",', '    textinfo="value+percent initial",')
source = source.replace(
    'Global Trade Volume Funnel by Commodity Category (2019-2022)',
    'Aid Distribution Funnel Across Implementation Stages (2015-2018)'
)
p.write_text(source)
exec(compile(source, "chart.py", "exec"))
